Daily Vehicle Report reads the notifications of WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business to find vehicle reports.

What is read: the group name, the sender's name and the message text of notifications from the WhatsApp group you choose (and only from the people you choose). Notifications from other apps and other chats are ignored and never stored.

Why: to mark your vehicles as reported and to build your daily reports (vehicle number, driver mobile, place, vendor).

Where it is kept: on this phone and in your account's private cloud copy, which only you can open. It is never sold or shared with anyone.

You can switch this off at any time in Android settings. Tap Agree to open the setting and allow "Daily Vehicle Report".
Turn on live reading of WhatsApp?

This optional feature uses Android's Accessibility service.

What is read: while it is on and WhatsApp is open on your screen, the text of the messages shown in your chosen group (vehicle numbers, driver mobiles, places, vendors and the sender's name). It works only inside WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business; it does not read other apps, and it never taps, types or does anything for you.

Why: to capture vehicle reports you scroll past, including older messages that have no notification.

Where it is kept: on this phone and in your account's private cloud copy, which only you can open. It is never sold or shared.

It switches itself off after the time you choose, and you can stop it at any time from the Live screen. Tap Agree to open Accessibility settings and turn on "Daily Vehicle Report – Live WhatsApp reader".
